Print labels for a batch of orders

Select the orders that leave with the next courier and print one label for every box in a single run.

Updated on 12 November 2026. Four minutes to read.

Before you start

Batch printing is in every plan. It works from the Orders page on a computer; the packing screen on a phone prints one label at a time.

  • Every order in the batch has a full delivery address and a courier.
  • The printer is on and holds the right labels. If you have not printed before, choose the label size first.
  • Your browser lets Counter open its print window. Allow pop-ups for the site if it asks.

Print the labels

  1. Open Orders and choose the filter To pack.
  2. Tick the orders that leave with the next courier. To take every order in the list, press CtrlA.
  3. Choose Print labels in the bar over the list, or press P.
  4. Check the count in the preview. Counter prints one label for each box, so 12 orders in 14 boxes give 14 labels.
  5. Press Print 14 labels. To leave without printing, press Esc.

Counter marks each order as labelled and adds its boxes to the next pickup, at 14:00 on courier days.

Printing again does not book a second pickup

A reprint replaces the first label and keeps the courier's code. Reprints are counted on the order, not charged.

Choose the label size

Counter prints two sizes. Set yours once in Settings, under Delivery, and every batch uses it.

Label Printer Paper
100 by 150 mm Label printer Roll of 500 labels
105 by 148 mm Any office printer A4 sheet of four labels

On a label printer

Choose 100 by 150 mm. The labels come out in the order of the list, so you can fill the boxes along the roll.

On A4 sheets

Choose 105 by 148 mm. When a batch does not fill its last sheet, put that sheet back in the tray: the preview of the next batch asks which label to start from.

If a label is wrong

Most wrong labels come from the order, not from the printer. Mend the order, then print that one label again from the order's own page.

The address is cut off

A label has room for five lines of address. Shorten the address in the order, then print that label again.

The courier's code is missing

The order has no courier yet. Open it, choose one under Delivery, and print the label again.

Nothing prints

Counter hands the labels to the print window of your browser. Check that the printer chosen there is the one with the labels in it, not the one for invoices.
